works.body:
My name is Ruri Aoyori and I am a Mahjong Vtuber.
I saw your illustration on Twitter.
I was attracted by the lively and detailed illustrations, and I asked if I could request an illustration to use in my activities.

Illustration of Ruri Aoyori
Illustration details
I would like to ask you to choose one of the following.
If you can illustrate by the end of this year
　Illustration for New Year's Eve
　Kimono or Japanese clothes
　Mahjong players or those who play Mahjong or those who have Mahjong-related items around them

(2) If it is easier to draw an illustration after the New Year or not in (1) above.
If the character is recognizable as Ruri Aoyori, there is no other specification. You are free to change the character's clothes, hairstyle, etc.
If you have a preference, please specify it,
Chinese style clothes
Mahjong game or mahjong related items around the character.
Illustrations in blue
I would be happy if you include elements such as the following

Format: PNG
■Size
　It is up to you.
■Usage
　Twitter posts and promotional images
　Thumbnails for YouTube, etc.

Please see the following tweets for standing pictures, tags, etc.
https://twitter.com/aoi___ruri/status/1687712989657575425

I would be happy if you could draw an illustration for me. Thank you very much.

https://lit.link/aoiRuri
